events.region: Dewey, SD; Potter, SD; Sully, SD
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1218 AM CDT /1118 PM MDT/, a severe thunderstorm was located 6
miles south of Swiftbird Day School, or 24 miles west of Gettysburg,
moving east at 25 mph.

THIS IS A DESTRUCTIVE STORM FOR SOUTHEAST DEWEY COUNTY MOVING INTO
WESTERN POTTER COUNTY AND THE VERY NORTHWEST CORNER OF SULLY COUNTY.

HAZARD...Three inch hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be severely injured. Expect
shattered windows, extensive damage to roofs, siding, and
vehicles.

This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Swiftbird Day School around 1225 AM CDT.
Swiftbird around 1230 AM CDT.
Whitlocks Bay Rec Area around 1240 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by the severe thunderstorm include Lake
Oahe.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 930 AM MST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry washes. Overflowing poor
drainage areas. Some low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 934 PM MST, gauge reports indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms fell in the middle and upper reaches of the Vamori
Wash this evening. This will cause small stream flooding. Rises
in the Vamori Wash could be sudden, but the flood wave will
slowly travel downstream.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
San Simon Wash, Hali Murk Wash, Chukut Kuk Wash, San Luis Wash
and Vamori Wash.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Cruz and Kupk.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
